description: A real Intel Mac client answering a live psistorm challenge: Mac Diablo II 1.14.3.71 (platform XMAC, product D2DV, verbyte 0x0E) on Mac OS X 10.13.6, connected to useast.battle.net, 2026-10-09. The raw CD-key part of the SID_AUTH_CHECK packet is not included.
files_not_hashed: The XMAC library ignores its file arguments (the client passes a path and two empty buffers). It hashes the main bundle's executable only.
notes: Server side (2026-10-09): useast accepted this answer (0x51 result 0, version check passed). c/psistorm.c built with c/psistorm_build_12.h and psistorm_ref.py both reproduce checksum and exe_info over the one file; the exe version is not the file tail (it is CFBundleVersion of the app).
The real psistorm-XMAC-12 library run in a fake Diablo II bundle gives the same values on arbitrary input: xmac-harness (280 of 280 cases over all 20 builds).
